You can tell they're terrified of losing right now, so they all want to play it safe and end up playing like [~0:cowards]. If they're going to get coached into this state, they stand no chance against the LCK. Playing safe and passively farming with zero early game tempo are two completely different things; passive farming just means waiting to get caught, letting the enemy dictate the tempo forever.
